title: Unified 5D Topology Component
description: Single neutral TopologyV1 model (Part/Anchor/Bond), shared TopologyStore, FiveD mode=flat|spatial component, cross-surface connect gestures, migrate playground and sketchpad.
summary: Introduced TopologyV1 (Part/Anchor/Bond), TopologyStore, FiveD flat|spatial component, topologyFromLegacyPair/projectFlat/projectSpatial. Added BoardLinkSessionSnapshot + WASM ExternalLinkPreview and Scene attractionSession for cross-surface connect preview. Migrated 5d play (TopologyStoreProvider on chrome) and sketchpad design windows to FiveD with per-design shared store map. Removed TopologyBoardPane/TopologyScenePane/dual-surface bindings. All @puzzle/2d/3d/5d react tests pass.
